label_rule: village within 15 km of a historical flood event (proximity proxy, NOT observed per-village outcomes)
elevation_source: Open-Meteo elevation API (also live at app runtime)
monsoon_source: Open-Meteo archive API (ERA5), 1991-01-01 to 2026-10-02; features = mean Jul-Sep seasonal total + linear trend of yearly totals; province-constant fallback used: False
river_source: hardcoded approximate waypoint polylines for Indus/Jhelum/Chenab/Ravi/Sutlej/Kabul; distance = min haversine to any waypoint (not true polyline distance)
limitations: Labels are proximity-based (15 km of historical events), not observed per-village flood outcomes.
Holdout metrics are optimistic: lat/lon features partly memorize event geography.
River polylines are approximate waypoint traces, not surveyed river geometry.
Curated event coordinates are district/city centroids (flagged in history CSV).
2025 events included; model cannot anticipate unprecedented extremes.
